rules.description: Magento Bypass Dynamic, Admin, API & Session Cookies
rules.expression: (not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/index.php") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/startrek")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/a79d3342ca_admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customer")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sales")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wishlist")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/rest")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/graphql")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/paypal")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/braintree")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sezzle")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogsearch")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/contact")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customform")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.php/api")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wholesale")) or (http.cookie contains "PHPSESSID=") or (http.cookie contains "X-Magento-Vary=") or (http.cookie contains "private_content_version=") or (http.cookie contains "login_as_customer")

rules.description: Magento Guest Storefront HTML Edge Cache
rules.expression: (http.host eq "www.smokeday.com") and (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/startrek")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/a79d3342ca_admin")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customer")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sales")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wishlist")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/rest")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/graphql")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/paypal")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/braintree")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sezzle")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogsearch")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/contact")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/customform")) and (not http.cookie contains "PHPSESSID=") and (not http.cookie contains "X-Magento-Vary=") and (not http.cookie contains "private_content_version=") and (not http.cookie contains "login_as_customer")
